items.prompt: A market BUY requests 10 shares but only 4 ask shares exist. What happens to the unfilled 6?

options.text: It rests as a new bid at the last traded price.
options.why: No limit price or resting instruction is supplied for a market remainder.

options.text: It trades against the bid side next.
options.why: A market BUY consumes asks, not same-side bids.

options.text: It is discarded after the ask side is exhausted.
options.why: The unfilled market remainder never becomes a resting order in this task.

options.text: It forces the earlier ask fill to roll back.
options.why: A partial available fill is not an all-or-none transaction here.

items.explanation: The unfilled market remainder never becomes a resting order in this task.
